decision_note: Approved as extracted. Anchor sc-06-02 Limited-quantity scarcity, capped grade C+; cap discharged upstream on the anchor, confidence unchanged. Notable as the only proposal in this batch that constrains the mechanism rather than amplifying it — it disables high-arousal scarcity indicators after repeated exposure in a session, which runs with SC-06's reactance boundary instead of against it.
